cases.notes: An escaped `_` inside a run of three or more underscores makes the whole run literal (§10.8); canonical escapes only the leftmost.
Deletion is semantically distinct from Obsolete and maps to editorial deletion.
Obsolete means retained-but-no-longer-accurate content; it is not an alias of Deletion.
No valid atomic sup token is formed; carets remain literal.

Structure is recognised before entity decoding: * decoding to * does not open Em. The AST is Text("*em*"); canonical escapes only the leftmost * (leftmost-effective rule, 10.8) so it round-trips to the same Text. The entity source is noncanonical in strict mode.
Closer recognition is stack-aware: inner Em closes before outer Strong.

Mid-line ~~~q~~~ takes the inline path: the atomic Sub closer on top of the stack closes before the outer Deletion delimiter. A line-start ~~~ run is a block fence instead (spec 10.11, 2.4, 15.1) -- see inline.deletion-sub.line-start-is-fence.

Block recognition wins over inline (15.1): a line beginning with three or more tildes is a code/math fence (2.4) with info token 'x~~~', not the inline ~~~x~~~ edge case. Unclosed, so a syntax error -- never an inline fallback.
A trailing backslash with nothing after it is a literal backslash, not a HardBreak carrier (spec 10.7).
A backslash with no content before it on its line is literal; the line boundary is a soft break.
Line 1 has content before the backslash and a following line -> HardBreak. Line 2 backslash has no content before it -> literal. No two break nodes adjacent.
The one committed named entity whose decoded value is LF: not decoded, stays literal text, no diagnostic (spec 10.8.1).
Numeric decimal/hex entities decoding to LF or CR are not decoded either.
Angle form with no space and balanced parens normalises to the bare destination.
A destination containing a space is canonical only in the angle form.
Balanced parentheses in a bare destination need no escaping.
A present empty title is distinct from an absent title.
A title is canonical only as a double-quoted string with one leading space.
<i>/<b> may span a paragraph SoftBreak and normalize to the canonical star surface.
A direct-link label may span a paragraph SoftBreak; destination and title remain line-local.
A nested Link or Autolink in a link label is forbidden.
NUL, surrogate, out-of-range, and digitless numeric references stay literal with no diagnostic.
&#X...; (uppercase X) is a valid hexadecimal reference; it decodes and the literal char is canonical.
An empty link label is error 10.3; an empty image alt stays valid.
A FootnoteReference renders as an anchor and is forbidden in a link label / image alt.
The Phase-2 parser still exposes a full-line image through its transitional inline surface; Phase 4 lowers it to ImageBlock.
A kindless inline MetadataSpan may carry lang and data-* only; group is a semantic context violation.
